name: Jade Jungle Temple — structural sections
prompt:
Create ONE clean detailed GAME ASSET REFERENCE SHEET, NOT Blender or a3Dmodel. Plain light ivory studio background, soft even light, full uncropped separate objects, readable thickness, precise non-melting forms. FULL IDs and names outside silhouettes, dimensions marked PROPOSED. Each cell independent illustration scale. No environment scenery, humans, extra unlabeled objects, watermark or whole-palace redesign. Use ONLY the single supplied source image for visible style/material/form authority; infer missing backs and assembly interfaces conservatively. Source illustration motifs are inspiration, not recovered measured geometry. Visible source facts: A steep jade/verdigris stepped temple with central stairs, gold seam bands, lotus-like roof crest and pointed gilded portals at successive terraces. Palms and fern planting frame the broad base; isometric shows compact setbacks rather than separate boxed wings. Hidden layout inference: Use a small shaded clearing as arrival, one strong central stair for the hero approach and a quieter side route linking terrace landings. Plant pockets flank entrances rather than blocking portals; make the upper shrine a framed destination with depth. Hidden rear return is inferred. Preserve this local design. Exactly4 large cells, large three-quarter view for each module plus small front, top and side/contact/section diagram consistent with same geometry. Real open doors/arches/windows must show empty space; no opaque filling where an opening is requested. Continuous unobstructed planar joining ends, separate shells from optional decor, no fused unrelated objects. Hollow roof/room sections show the interior underside and wall thickness. Keep source silhouette, not generic boxes. Title "B15-STRUCT-001 — Jade Jungle Temple — structural sections". Footer "Proposed construction / source-compatible references / mesh joins and views unverified".

Purpose/gap: Need beveled/setback wall hosts, terrace/step returns, portal reveal/lotus crest seat and gold band corners. Existing jade/lotus/gold patterns retained, not recoloured to palace marble. Distinct jungle canopy/palms/vines/epiphytes and birds/geckos/beetles still require audit; shared moss/rocks/water reused. Provide missing isolated hosts and join views.

B15-STRUCT-001-S01 — Setback jade wall. Dimensions W,D,H [8, 6, 12]m proposed. One isolated setback jade wall matching the supplied building, its roof/arch/wall silhouette and local materials. Show front and interior/rear/underside contact, not a complete building scene. Actual open column galleries and holes stay open. Extend hidden depth only enough to form a joinable section; no palace-wide plan or added unrelated tower.
